title: Tractable Shape Grammars
edition_version: Version of record unless otherwise noted
relevance: This paper investigates why unrestricted shape computation can become computationally difficult and what restrictions make useful practical algorithms possible. Parametric recognition is a central example.
prerequisites: Undergraduate algebra and linear algebra; additional prerequisites in topic notes

license_redistribution.conditions: No public redistribution permission verified; citation and lawful reading link only.
